Frequently asked questions

01How much does it cost to distribute my content?

Terms depend on the type of content, the distribution model, the available rights and the collaboration framework. Each submission is reviewed before defining any agreement.

02Do I keep the rights to my work?

Yes. Submitting content does not automatically transfer your rights. Any distribution must be framed by a clear agreement.

03Which formats do you accept?

MyTelevision can review films, series, documentaries, podcasts, radio, replays, shows, event recordings, youth content or catalogues, depending on their quality, rights and fit with the platform.

04How quickly will I hear back?

Timing can vary depending on the volume of requests and the complexity of the project. The team gets back to you once your submission has been reviewed.

05Can I submit content already broadcast elsewhere?

Yes, if you hold the necessary rights and if the existing distribution conditions allow it.

06Can I submit a TV channel, a radio or a podcast?

Yes. This page is open to creators, channels, radio stations, podcasters, producers and rights holders who want to present a project or a piece of content.

07Is my information confidential?

The information you share is handled confidentially and in accordance with the MyTelevision privacy policy.

FAQ

Compatibility questions

Everything you need to know before you start.

01Can I watch without installing an app?

Yes. MyTelevision is available directly from your web browser, with no installation.

02Is the app available on mobile?

Yes: the iPhone and Android apps are available. The website also adapts to your phone, with the same account.

03Is it compatible with my Smart TV?

Not directly yet: Smart TV apps are in preparation. Meanwhile, MyTelevision works in the browser and on iPhone, iPad and Android.

04Do my favourites sync across devices?

Yes: your list and playback progress are tied to your account, on every screen where you are signed in.
